summary: Donor-level CSF proteomic reanalysis in Trautwig 2025 (Emory TMTpro N=101; 4-center DIA-MS N=259: Emory 118, MGH 78, WashU 32, UMilan 31; sALS n=50 vs Control n=72) and Oh 2023 (Table 2) with proteome-wide BH-FDR, contrast-inversion audit, and center/batch/age/sex OLS sensitivity.

Paired Frontal-minus-Cerebellar reanalysis in Prudencio GSE67196 (N=15 donors) and donor-deduplicated NYGC ALS Consortium reanalysis across 4 CNS regions + O'Neill 2025 ALS-Glia strata with RIN, Prep/Platform, GC-content, and neuronal/glial/endothelial cell-proportion sensitivity.

Donor-aggregated snRNA-seq cell-type specificity and ALS vs Control DE across cortical lineages in Edinburgh GSE290359 (34 unique donors across BA4/BA6/BA9) plus spatial spinal cord DE across MN and TDP-43+ anterior horn niches in Zhang 2026 (DS031_ZHANG).

Tri-Pillar genomics, AlphaGenome IL1RL1 regulatory/splicing variant scoring (rs1420101, rs1041973, rs953934), GTEx v10 54-tissue expression/eQTLs, gnomAD v4 constraints & CHIT1 rs3831317 null allele audit, OpenTargets L2G/tractability, ClinicalTrials.gov complement/ST2/CHIT1 audit, and 5-dimension gene-liability scoring.
